'''Ulthar Blaze''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Spy/Legends|secret agent]], Blaze infiltrated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by posing as a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] from the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], and he was assigned to serve as the assistant of the Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Grendreef/Legends|Grendreef]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Miser/Legends|Miser]]. After the Empire discovered the location of the Alliance-held world [[Isis/Legends|Isis]], a group of Rebel agents were imprisoned on Miser and Blaze helped the agents to escape. By disguising themselves as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Blaze and the agents were subsequently able to board the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Desolator'']] and erase Isis' co-ordinates from the vessel's [[Computer/Legends|computer]].
